title.en: wimbledon park fireworks, two shows and a funfair.

line.en: bonfire night at wimbledon park: a children's display at 18:45, the main show at 20:30. gates open at 17:15; tickets are likely to sell out, so book early.
line.de: bonfire night im wimbledon park: kinder-show um 18:45, hauptshow um 20:30. einlass ab 17:15; die tickets sind wohl schnell weg, also früh buchen.
line.tr: wimbledon park'ta bonfire night: 18:45'te çocuk gösterisi, 20:30'da ana gösteri. kapılar 17:15'te açılıyor; biletler çabuk tükenebilir, erken al.

sparks.why: Wimbledon Park fireworks on Thu 5 Nov 2026, gates 5.15pm, children's show 6.45pm, main show 8.30pm (IanVisits and Ents24 listings); adult tickets quoted at £15.90. Merton Council page not reached.
